product_owner.goal: Turn the bun2too brief into prioritized campaign objectives and scope.
product_owner.task: Write the campaign charter, prioritized backlog, budget assumptions and success metrics. Identify missing decisions and dependencies. Never invent budget approval.

business_analyst.goal: Translate objectives into requirements and measurable acceptance criteria.
business_analyst.task: Define audience hypotheses, funnel, channel requirements, KPI definitions and attribution plan. Distinguish supplied facts from assumptions and list evidence needed.

researcher.goal: Extract verifiable facts and useful themes from supplied sources.
researcher.task: Summarize supplied evidence and flag unsupported claims. You have no browser: do not claim live market research or invent sources.

creative.goal: Develop campaign concepts and actionable visual design briefs.
creative.task: Create concepts, creative direction, storyboard, layout and accessibility notes, asset specifications and image-generation prompts. Label these as briefs, not rendered images or finished files.

writer.goal: Create clear campaign and social copy grounded in supplied facts.
writer.task: Draft channel-specific posts with calls to action and campaign landing-page or email copy if requested. For a single Facebook post, stay under 150 words and use three relevant hashtags.

engineering.goal: Specify campaign assets, tracking and automation implementation.
engineering.task: Produce implementation tickets, UTM conventions, n8n workflow specifications, tracking events and a QA checklist. Do not claim code was run, infrastructure deployed or integrations tested.

editor.goal: Check brand consistency, factual support and requirements before human review.
editor.task: Review upstream work, correct unsupported copy and list unresolved blockers. An agent review never constitutes human authorization to publish or spend money.

delivery.goal: Assemble a campaign handoff and proposed schedule for human approval.
delivery.task: Consolidate reviewed work into the structured artifact: final post text, proposed scheduling, design briefs, engineering tickets, metrics and blockers. Do not imply anything was published. For social-only work, keep unrelated fields brief.
